skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cleaning] — You wipe down the nearest surface out of old habit. It gleams.
skills.description: Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
Steadier hands with any blade.
A frame hardened by work and worse.
Everything behind one blow.
The next blade that finds you meets an answer.
A felled foe quickens the blood.
A hissing dart of goblin fire.
A roaring lance of goblin-fire down the line.
A dart of biting cold that clings to the legs.
Woven mana drinks the blow before flesh does.
The first spell leaves the fingers before the thought finishes.

skills.field_ambient: [Light] — A steady white orb rises to follow you, throwing back the dark.
skills.description: A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
The feet decide before the mind does.
Breath returns, and the body remembers it can go on.
A cold prickle at the neck, a heartbeat before harm.
Thrusts that seek the seams in any guard.
A cut loosed before the guard can rise.
One bright line. The eye catches up too late.
Mid-swing, the blade bends its path toward whatever is unguarded.
Three points of pain in a single breath.
A wide, raking arc that finds an opening no straight thrust could.
For one moment the air is stitched with spearpoints.
A fist-sized spike of ice, hurled hard enough to crack shields.
The stones glaze over, and footing becomes a rumor.
An arm's-length arc of fire, reaped close.
A snap of light and heat that leaves spots dancing in the eyes.
Mana runs down the blade until the edge sings.
Chores that would tire another barely slow you.

skills.field_ambient: [Basic Cooking] — You picture the dish this place is missing. Your hands twitch toward a ladle that isn't there.
skills.description: Simple meals come out right, every time.
Trays, kegs, and crates feel lighter than they should.

skills.field_ambient: [Observe] — You take in the empty space around you. Nothing here rewards a closer look.
skills.description: A measuring look that reads a room, a person, a problem — and files it away for later.
The whole field resolves into a map. You always know the one step that matters.

skills.field_ambient: [Soothe Clientele] — You offer the empty room a calming word. Only the dust settles.
skills.description: A word and a refilled glass, and the room's troubles ease — patrons forget whatever was gnawing at them.

skills.field_ambient: [Unerring Aim] — You size up a throw out of habit. Nothing here is worth the toss.
skills.description: Whatever you throw finds its mark — a mug slid down the bar, a rag, or a troublemaker's head.

skills.field_ambient: [Sweep the Tables] — You reach to clear the dishes. The tables here are already bare.
skills.description: A cluttered table comes clean in a single pass, the dishes spirited back to the kitchen.

skills.field_ambient: [Server's Prescience] — You listen for what the room needs next. All quiet, for now.
skills.description: You know what a guest wants before they raise a hand — the empty cup, the missing fork, the order about to be called.

skills.field_ambient: [Charming Smile] — You flash a warm, easy smile at no one in particular. A passing sparrow seems charmed, at least.
skills.description: A warm, disarming smile that puts people at ease and turns a cold first meeting friendly.
A steadying word and a calming hand; the fight drains out of a foe, and their guard turns slow and uncertain.

skills._comment: M-ARC A2: the Awakened Raskghar's signature (enemy-only; no class grants it). A REACHING heavy swing realized on the EXISTING frost_bolt/[Calming Touch] applies-rider machinery -- spell_damage + the same `slowed` pool_penalty rider, NO new effect type. range 2 (a hulking bear-lion's reach) is deliberate: it is the only value that lets the boss's `caster` AI actually FIRE the slow under the shipped combat_ai.gd -- a range-1 swing makes the ranged AI kite-then-never-cast, a range-2 swing makes it maintain reach and land the maul every turn (task-a2 report AI-fit analysis). die/ap_cost balance-tuned via sim_combat_batch.gd BOSS_CELLS to hold the 0.6-0.75 Relc band; slowed pool_penalty is the shared status (WICombat._start_turn expiry, identical to frost_bolt).
skills.description: A sweeping, reaching swipe of claw and forearm that batters the legs out from under you and leaves them slow to answer.

skills._comment: Skills Wave Task K1: the frost field seam's caster skill. `freezes: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on (use_skill_field): faced at a freezable water cell -> walkable ice until sleep. Exploration-only (no combat/mp_cost), so it is fight-determinism-neutral exactly like [Light] -- safe to grant a QA fixture without perturbing any fight. NAME is provisional (K3 owns canon Skill naming + class grants; wiki-verify + wire a real gained_by there). `freeze_toast` overrides the seam's default cast line.
skills.freeze_toast: [Frost Touch] — You lay your palm to the water and cold spiders out from it. In a breath the channel locks to grey-white ice, thick enough to bear your weight. It will not last past your next rest.
skills.field_ambient: [Frost Touch] — Frost blooms from your fingers and hangs glittering in the air. There is nothing here for it to grip.
skills.description: A breath of deep cold that skins still water in load-bearing ice.

skills._comment: Skills Wave Task K1: the burnable-prop field seam's caster skill. `burns: true` is the ONLY tag the seam keys on: faced at a prop tagged `burnable: true` -> the prop is removed permanently (removed_entities, saved) + a burn poof. Exploration-only, fight-determinism-neutral like frost_touch/[Light]. NAME provisional (K3 canon-verify + class grant).
skills.field_ambient: [Kindle] — A curl of flame dances up over your knuckles and gutters out. Nothing here will take the fire.
skills.description: A conjured flame, hot enough to take dry debris and old timber in moments.
